description: Entitlement-only policy for the ZKredential ComplianceGateway mint path. Derived from the project README and source (see findings/zkredential/policy.md). States who may receive the minted token; states no expected outcome.

roles.proof_wallet: the account named by the compliant proof's public walletAddress (pubSignals[10])
roles.mint_recipient: the account entitled to receive the minted RWA token

notes: The source provides no amount signal or issuance entitlement, so the authorized mint amount cannot be inferred and no amount entitlement is stated. The proof wallet binding (pubSignals[10]) has README/source support; see findings/zkredential/policy.md for the conditional-policy caveats.
